title_en: Wonders of Chinese Engineering (14/20): The High-Speed Train Factory
note_en: 又 does two jobs in this text. Inside a phrase, 又 links two qualities of one thing: 轻便又坚固的铝合金材料 "aluminum alloy that is light yet strong." Paired with 既, it links two results: 这样既能减轻重量，又能保证安全 "this both reduces weight and ensures safety." English just uses "and" or "both… and…," but in Chinese the second item is marked with 又 placed right before the adjective or verb.
